project.name: adapted
project.description: Intelligent Adaptive Education Assistant - multi-agent AI education platform.

nodes.name: deps.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency layer providing JWT bearer authentication, role-based access guards, and ownership/enrollment assertion helpers shared by every router.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes FastAPI Depends/OAuth2PasswordBearer so routers declare authentication declaratively through parameter annotations.

nodes.name: get_current_user
nodes.summary: Decodes the OAuth2 bearer JWT, loads the matching User row, and raises 401 on missing/invalid tokens or unknown users.

nodes.name: require_role
nodes.summary: Factory returning a FastAPI dependency that rejects requests whose user role is not in the allowed set.

nodes.name: get_teacher_row
nodes.summary: Fetches the Teacher profile row for the current user or raises 403 when none exists.

nodes.name: get_student_row
nodes.summary: Fetches the Student profile row for the current user or raises 403 when none exists.

nodes.name: assert_course_owner
nodes.summary: Guard asserting a course exists (404) and belongs to the acting teacher (403) before mutations.

nodes.name: assert_student_enrolled
nodes.summary: Guard verifying an Enrollment row links the student to the course, raising 403 otherwise.

nodes.name: agent.py
nodes.summary: POST /agent/run endpoint that validates agent intents and dispatches pipeline execution to the background task runner, returning a started-task result immediately.

nodes.name: AgentRunRequest
nodes.summary: Request body pairing an agent intent string with its arbitrary JSON payload.

nodes.name: run_agent_pipeline
nodes.summary: Validates the requested intent, submits the pipeline to the background runner, and maps unknown intents or submission failures to HTTP errors.

nodes.name: agent_ops.py
nodes.summary: Observability endpoints listing agent tasks, inter-agent messages and runs, fronted by a stale-task reaper that fails tasks stuck in 'started' beyond the time budget.

nodes.name: reap_stale_tasks
nodes.summary: Marks AgentTask rows still 'started' past the 60-minute cutoff as failed so server restarts cannot strand zombie tasks.

nodes.name: list_tasks
nodes.summary: Returns recent agent tasks newest-first with an optional workflow filter after reaping stale entries.

nodes.name: get_task
nodes.summary: Polls a single agent task by id including its result payload, used by the UI notifier.

nodes.name: list_messages
nodes.summary: Lists inter-agent bus messages optionally filtered by task or correlation id.

nodes.name: agent_runs
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent pipeline runs for the operations dashboard.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: Registration and login endpoints that hash passwords, create User rows plus Teacher/Student profiles, and issue JWT-backed TokenResponses.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Creates a user account with bcrypt-hashed password, provisions the role-specific Teacher or Student profile, and returns an access token.

nodes.name: login
nodes.summary: Verifies email/password credentials with bcrypt and issues a fresh JWT wrapped in a TokenResponse.

nodes.name: courses.py
nodes.summary: Course router covering creation, role-scoped listing, enrollment, document upload/listing/status, and cascading deletes (document, contents, whole course) with audit logging and on-disk file cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: _purge_course_data deletes course-bound rows in FK-safe order using bulk delete()/update() statements before removing the course itself.

nodes.name: create_course
nodes.summary: Teacher-only course creation that persists the Course row, audits the action, and returns the DTO.

nodes.name: list_courses
nodes.summary: Role-scoped listing: teachers see owned courses, students see courses they are enrolled in.

nodes.name: get_course
nodes.summary: Fetches a single course, authorizing either the owning teacher or an enrolled student.

nodes.name: enroll_student
nodes.summary: Idempotent enrollment endpoint guarded by course ownership, rejecting unknown students with 404.

nodes.name: upload_document
nodes.summary: Validates document extension and size, streams the file into storage/documents, records a Document row pending analysis, and audits the upload.

nodes.name: list_documents
nodes.summary: Lists a course's uploaded documents newest-first for authorized viewers.

nodes.name: get_document_status
nodes.summary: Returns a document's processing status/error for polling after upload.

nodes.name: delete_document
nodes.summary: Deletes a document along with its generated chapters (cascading topics/lessons) and unlinks the stored file.

nodes.name: clear_course_contents
nodes.summary: Purges all course-bound data while keeping the course shell itself intact.

nodes.name: delete_course
nodes.summary: Removes the course after purging all dependent data and unlinked files.

nodes.name: _get_owned_course
nodes.summary: Resolves a course for a teacher, distinguishing 404 missing from 403 foreign-owned.

nodes.name: _unlink_file
nodes.summary: Best-effort removal of an uploaded file from disk with a logged warning on failure.

nodes.name: _purge_course_data
nodes.summary: Bulk-deletes every row tied to a course in FK-safe order (plans, quizzes, lessons, chapters, documents, enrollments, history, recommendations) and clears related vector chunks and conversation links.

nodes.name: _build_document_out
nodes.summary: Maps a Document ORM row to its DocumentOut DTO including derived page count and size.

nodes.name: _course_out
nodes.summary: Maps a Course row to CourseOut, computing the enrolled-student count via a scalar subquery.

nodes.name: _audit
nodes.summary: Appends an AuditLog row recording actor, action, resource and detail for course/document mutations.

nodes.name: curriculum.py
nodes.summary: Read-only curriculum endpoints serving generated chapters and topics (with objectives and prerequisites) to authorized teachers and enrolled students.

nodes.name: _topic_out
nodes.summary: Builds the TopicOut DTO including learning objectives and prerequisite topic titles.

nodes.name: get_curriculum
nodes.summary: Returns the full curriculum for a course, grouping topics under their ordered chapters.

nodes.name: get_topic
nodes.summary: Fetches a single topic with objectives and prerequisites for lesson generation flows.

nodes.name: lessons.py
nodes.summary: Lesson endpoints that perform fast authorization checks, dispatch asynchronous lesson generation through the background task runner, and serve generated lessons to authorized viewers.

nodes.name: LessonGenerateRequest
nodes.summary: Request contract carrying course, topic, optional student and difficulty level for lesson generation.

nodes.name: generate_lesson
nodes.summary: Validates course/topic existence then submits the generate_lesson pipeline to the background runner instead of blocking the request.

nodes.name: get_lesson
nodes.summary: Fetches a lesson gated to its owning student, enrolled classmates, or the course teacher.

nodes.name: logs.py
nodes.summary: Teacher-only audit-log listing endpoint returning the most recent audit entries for the operations view.

nodes.name: audit_logs
nodes.summary: Returns AuditLog rows newest-first with a configurable limit.

nodes.name: quizzes.py
nodes.summary: Quiz lifecycle router: async quiz generation, answer-safe retrieval, and submission which persists attempt/answer rows before launching the grading chain in the background.

nodes.name: generate_quiz
nodes.summary: Checks course existence and student enrollment then submits the generate_quiz pipeline asynchronously.

nodes.name: get_quiz
nodes.summary: Thin retrieval wrapper delegating DTO assembly to _quiz_out.

nodes.name: submit_quiz
nodes.summary: Guards against duplicate attempts and missing student profiles, persists QuizAttempt plus Answer rows in one commit, then submits the quiz_submit pipeline returning task and attempt ids immediately.

nodes.name: _quiz_out
nodes.summary: Assembles QuizOut with ordered questions while stripping correct answers and explanations so they never leak to students.

nodes.name: students.py
nodes.summary: Student analytics endpoints (profile, performance, mastery, recommendations, preferences) with self-or-owning-teacher authorization and a default-course fallback.

nodes.name: _authorize
nodes.summary: Access gate allowing the student themself or any teacher who teaches a course the student is enrolled in.

nodes.name: get_student_profile
nodes.summary: Aggregates the student's profile (mastery, history, preferences) via build_profile.

nodes.name: get_performance
nodes.summary: Returns weak/strong topics, per-topic mastery and detected misconceptions for a course.

nodes.name: get_mastery
nodes.summary: Serves the per-topic mastery snapshot for a student's default or explicit course.

nodes.name: get_recommendations
nodes.summary: Lists the student's most recent recommendations newest-first.

nodes.name: update_recommendation
nodes.summary: Marks a recommendation applied or dismissed on behalf of its authorized student.

nodes.name: set_student_preference
nodes.summary: Persists a learning preference key/value pair after validating both fields are present.

nodes.name: _default_course_id
nodes.summary: Picks the student's most recent enrollment visible to the requester as the default course context.

nodes.name: study_plans.py
nodes.summary: Study-plan read endpoints returning the active plan (highest version) with its daily items, authorized for the owning student or their teacher.

nodes.name: _plan_out
nodes.summary: Builds StudyPlanOut with day-by-day items enriched with topic titles and goals.

nodes.name: get_study_plan
nodes.summary: Returns the active study plan for a specific student-course pair, 404 when none exists.

nodes.name: get_student_study_plan
nodes.summary: Convenience endpoint resolving the student's latest active plan across courses before authorization.

nodes.name: _authorize
nodes.summary: Course-scoped access gate delegating to the shared enrollment assertion dependency.

nodes.name: users.py
nodes.summary: Teacher-only user directory search over name/email that joins Student rows to expose grade level and daily study minutes for enrollment pickers.

nodes.name: search_users
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive ilike filtering across full_name/email with an optional role filter, enriching results with joined Student metadata.

nodes.name: session.py
nodes.summary: Database bootstrap: resolves and connect-probes the PostgreSQL URL (fail-fast, Postgres-only), exposes SessionLocal/get_db/session_scope helpers plus ID generators and init/reset routines including pgvector extension setup.
nodes.languageNotes: Engine and SessionLocal are created at module import time, so importing any adapted module requires a reachable PostgreSQL instance - the intended fail-fast behavior.

nodes.name: _resolve_database_url
nodes.summary: Validates the DATABASE_URL scheme, probes it with SELECT 1 at import time, and raises a descriptive RuntimeError for missing/unsupported/unreachable databases.

nodes.name: get_db
nodes.summary: Request-scoped SQLAlchemy session generator used as a FastAPI dependency.

nodes.name: session_scope
nodes.summary: Context manager yielding a session that commits on success and rolls back then closes on error.

nodes.name: init_db
nodes.summary: Creates the pgvector extension if missing and builds all ORM tables via Base.metadata.create_all.

nodes.name: reset_db
nodes.summary: Drops and recreates all ORM tables; silently no-ops when models have not been imported yet.

nodes.name: db_add
nodes.summary: Add-commit-refresh convenience wrapper returning the persisted object.

nodes.name: api.py
nodes.summary: Complete Pydantic v2 API contract layer: request/response models for auth, courses, documents, curriculum, study plans, lessons, quizzes, grading results, performance/mastery, recommendations, and agent observability payloads.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic v2 BaseModel declarations validating SQLAlchemy rows directly for serialization.

nodes.name: RegisterRequest
nodes.summary: Signup payload with email, password, full name, role and optional student attributes (grade level, daily study minutes).

nodes.name: LoginRequest
nodes.summary: Email and password credential pair for the login endpoint.

nodes.name: TokenResponse
nodes.summary: JWT access token response embedding the authenticated UserOut.

nodes.name: UserOut
nodes.summary: Public user shape exposing role and optional student grade/daily-minutes fields.

nodes.name: CourseCreate
nodes.summary: Course creation payload with title plus optional subject, description and exam date.

nodes.name: CourseOut
nodes.summary: Course DTO including status, timestamps and the computed enrolled-student count.

nodes.name: EnrollRequest
nodes.summary: Wrapper carrying the student id to enroll in a course.

nodes.name: DocumentOut
nodes.summary: Uploaded-document metadata including file type/size, page count and processing status/error.

nodes.name: TopicOut
nodes.summary: Curriculum topic DTO with difficulty, learning objectives and prerequisite topic titles.

nodes.name: ChapterOut
nodes.summary: Chapter DTO nesting its ordered topics and source references.

nodes.name: CurriculumOut
nodes.summary: Top-level curriculum response pairing a course id with its chapters.

nodes.name: PlanItemOut
nodes.summary: Study-plan day item DTO with sequence, estimated minutes, goal, reason and completion status.

nodes.name: StudyPlanOut
nodes.summary: Study-plan header DTO with version, exam date, daily minutes and nested items.

nodes.name: LessonSection
nodes.summary: Named content block composing a generated lesson.

nodes.name: LessonOut
nodes.summary: Lesson DTO carrying level, sections and the RAG chunk provenance used to ground generation.

nodes.name: QuestionOut
nodes.summary: Quiz question DTO deliberately omitting correct answers and explanations.

nodes.name: QuizOut
nodes.summary: Quiz DTO with quiz type/status and its sanitized question list.

nodes.name: QuizGenerateRequest
nodes.summary: Generation parameters covering count, difficulty, question types, quiz type and optional topic/student scoping.

nodes.name: QuizSubmitRequest
nodes.summary: Submission payload mapping each question id to its raw answer value.

nodes.name: AnswerGradeOut
nodes.summary: Per-answer grading result including AI score, confidence, explanation and the needs_teacher_review flag.

nodes.name: GradingResultOut
nodes.summary: Attempt-level grading summary pairing score/max/percentage with the graded answer list.

nodes.name: MasteryOut
nodes.summary: Per-topic mastery snapshot with attempt count and status label.

nodes.name: MisconceptionOut
nodes.summary: Detected misconception card with topic, label, description and resolution status.

nodes.name: PerformanceOut
nodes.summary: Aggregated performance view combining weak/strong topics, per-topic mastery and misconceptions.

nodes.name: RecommendationOut
nodes.summary: Recommendation DTO with action, reasons, payload, confidence and application status.

nodes.name: AgentMessageOut
nodes.summary: Observability record of an inter-agent bus message including sender/receiver, action payload and duration.

nodes.name: AgentTaskOut
nodes.summary: Agent task DTO for polling: workflow/intent, status, error, result context, retries and timing.

nodes.name: PipelineResult
nodes.summary: Immediate response to accepted pipeline runs carrying task id, correlation id and status.

nodes.name: jwt.py
nodes.summary: Minimal JWT helper pair for issuing expiring HS-signed access tokens and decoding them during request authentication.

nodes.name: create_access_token
nodes.summary: Encodes subject/role claims with an expiry into a signed JWT using the configured secret.

nodes.name: passwords.py
nodes.summary: bcrypt password hashing and constant-time verification wrappers used by registration and login.

nodes.name: verify_password
nodes.summary: Checks a plaintext password against its stored bcrypt hash via bcrypt.checkpw.

nodes.name: runner.py
nodes.summary: Background task runner: persists AgentTask rows, submits pipeline execution to a ThreadPoolExecutor whose workers build their own sessions/runtime, and guarantees failure marking on crashes.
nodes.languageNotes: Worker threads create their own SQLAlchemy SessionLocal because sessions are not thread-safe; the executor decouples slow free-tier LLM runs from HTTP request lifetimes.

nodes.name: submit_pipeline
nodes.summary: Creates the task record through Supervisor in its own short-lived session, commits it, and enqueues execution on the shared executor.

nodes.name: _run_in_thread
nodes.summary: Worker entry point constructing AgentRuntime with the configured LLM provider and message bus, running the pipeline, and marking the task failed on any exception.

nodes.name: _mark_failed
nodes.summary: Best-effort terminal failure writer using a fresh session so crashed pipelines never stay 'started'.

nodes.name: lesson_agent.py
nodes.summary: Generates levelled lesson content for a curriculum topic by combining RAG-retrieved textbook chunks, learning objectives and the student profile into a schema-validated LLM request, then persists the resulting Lesson row.
nodes.languageNotes: Pydantic output models double as the JSON schema contract handed to the LLM provider.

nodes.name: SectionOut
nodes.summary: Pydantic model describing one titled lesson section (name plus markdown content).

nodes.name: LessonOutput
nodes.summary: Structured LLM response contract holding title, difficulty level, sections and a reference list.

nodes.name: LessonAgent
nodes.summary: Content-producing agent that retrieves topic context, builds a prompt, generates a validated LessonOutput via the LLM provider, persists a Lesson entity and flags empty outputs so the runtime retries with backoff.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Central pydantic-settings configuration loaded from the repo-root .env: app metadata, PostgreSQL URL, OpenRouter LLM/embedding settings, JWT secrets, RAG limits and retry knobs.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.summary: Typed application settings (database URL, provider credentials and timeouts, RAG limits) with helpers for password-redacted URLs, CORS origin parsing and storage-path creation.

nodes.name: get_settings
nodes.summary: Returns the lru-cached Settings instance used as the app-wide configuration accessor.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the provider-agnostic LLM contract: a request envelope pairing a prompt with its JSON schema, and the abstract LLMProvider interface every chat/embedding backend implements.

nodes.name: LLMRequest
nodes.summary: Request object carrying a task label, prompt, expected JSON schema, sampling temperature and free-form metadata for the provider.

nodes.name: LLMProvider
nodes.summary: Abstract base class defining generate (schema-constrained chat completion), embed (mode-aware vectors) and the is_mock capability flag.

nodes.name: mock.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic offline LLM provider: seeded generators fabricate curricula, lessons, quizzes, grades and recommendations without network access, plus hash-based pseudo-embeddings for fully reproducible runs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses sha256-derived seeds so identical inputs always yield identical outputs, keeping offline end-to-end runs deterministic.

nodes.name: _mock_curriculum
nodes.summary: Builds a subject-aware fake curriculum (chapters, ordered topics and prerequisite links) keyed off keywords in the document metadata and excerpt.

nodes.name: _mock_lesson
nodes.summary: Assembles a canned multi-section lesson (explanation, examples, practice questions, summary) adapted to the requested topic and difficulty level.

nodes.name: _mock_quiz
nodes.summary: Seed-driven quiz generator drawing MCQ/true-false/numeric items from a per-subject question bank and synthesising deterministic fallbacks when the bank runs short.

nodes.name: _mock_grade
nodes.summary: Heuristic grader comparing normalised student responses against correct answers, using numeric tolerance and token-overlap scoring with confidence values for subjective answers.

nodes.name: _mock_recommendation
nodes.summary: Produces simple review/practise action recommendations from weak and strong topic lists.

nodes.name: MockProvider
nodes.summary: LLMProvider implementation that dispatches task-labelled requests to the mock_* handlers and returns deterministic hash-seeded unit-normalised embedding vectors.

nodes.name: openai_compatible.py
nodes.summary: Production provider speaking the OpenAI wire protocol against OpenRouter: JSON-schema-constrained chat generation plus dimension-validated embeddings, bounded by the configured request timeout.

nodes.name: OpenAICompatibleProvider
nodes.summary: Chat and embedding client over the OpenAI SDK that injects schemas into prompts, parses JSON replies (logging failures loudly) and verifies returned vectors match EMBEDDING_DIM.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Maps the configured provider names to concrete LLM/embedding implementations behind lru-cached accessors, warning and degrading to MockProvider when OpenRouter credentials are absent.

nodes.name: get_provider
nodes.summary: Instantiates the chat provider selected by settings.llm_provider, falling back to MockProvider with a warning for unknown values or missing keys.

nodes.name: get_embed_provider
nodes.summary: Instantiates the embedding provider independently of the chat provider, selecting between the OpenRouter-compatible client and the deterministic mock backend.

nodes.name: get_provider_cached
nodes.summary: lru_cache-wrapped chat provider accessor reused across requests instead of rebuilding clients.

nodes.name: get_embed_provider_cached
nodes.summary: lru_cache-wrapped embedding provider accessor reused by the RAG layer for every embed call.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application factory: initialises the PostgreSQL schema on startup, wires CORS, registers every API router (auth, courses, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, students, teacher, users, agent ops, logs) and exposes /health.
nodes.languageNotes: The lifespan hook fails fast when PostgreSQL is unreachable; there is deliberately no SQLite fallback.

nodes.name: lifespan
nodes.summary: Async startup/shutdown hook that creates the database schema (and logs readiness) before the server accepts traffic.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Builds and configures the FastAPI app: CORS middleware, mounting of all domain routers, and a health endpoint reporting masked database and provider configuration.

nodes.name: curriculum_memory.py
nodes.summary: Indexes parsed documents into pgvector-backed ContentChunks (chunking, passage embeddings, vector upserts) and links chunks to generated curriculum topics for later retrieval.

nodes.name: index_document
nodes.summary: Re-indexes a document: deletes stale chunks and vectors, chunks pages, embeds passages in query-aware mode and upserts vectors alongside freshly inserted ContentChunk rows.

nodes.name: assign_chunk_topics
nodes.summary: Binds a set of chunk ids to their chapter/topic pair once the curriculum analyzer has produced the topic tree.

nodes.name: chunker.py
nodes.summary: Splits parsed document pages into overlapping, heading-aware text chunks carrying page ranges so retrieved passages can be cited.

nodes.name: Chunk
nodes.summary: Value object for one indexed text chunk: order index, content, page range and nearest heading.

nodes.name: chunk_document
nodes.summary: Streams pages into heading-delimited units, flushing fixed-size chunks with character overlap and merged page spans into Chunk objects.

nodes.name: embeddings.py
nodes.summary: Thin caching facade over the configured embedding provider: embeds single texts or batches in passage/query modes for indexing and retrieval.

nodes.name: _embed_single
nodes.summary: Embeds one string through the cached embed provider with the requested passage/query mode, LRU-cached by text+mode.

nodes.name: embed_texts
nodes.summary: Batch-embeds multiple texts (mapping over _embed_single) or delegates the whole list to the provider in one call.

nodes.name: embed_text
nodes.summary: Single-text convenience wrapper returning one embedding vector.

nodes.name: parser.py
nodes.summary: Extracts clean per-page text from uploaded PDF, TXT/MD and DOCX course materials into a ParsedDocument structure, raising UnsupportedDocumentError for anything else.

nodes.name: UnsupportedDocumentError
nodes.summary: Raised when an upload has an unsupported extension or yields no extractable text.

nodes.name: Page
nodes.summary: One numbered page of extracted document text.

nodes.name: ParsedDocument
nodes.summary: Parsed upload holding filename plus pages, with full-text join and page-count helpers used by chunking and analysis.

nodes.name: parse_document
nodes.summary: Dispatches on file extension to the PDF/text/DOCX parsers and rejects unsupported formats with a helpful error.

nodes.name: _parse_pdf
nodes.summary: Reads PDF pages via PdfReader, cleans extracted text per page and refuses empty or scanned PDFs.

nodes.name: _parse_docx
nodes.summary: Flattens DOCX paragraphs into cleaned single-page text using python-docx.

nodes.name: retriever.py
nodes.summary: Query-side retrieval: embeds the question, runs filtered cosine search over the vector store and formats top chunks (with optional citations) into LLM context blocks.

nodes.name: RetrievedChunk
nodes.summary: Retrieved hit with content, similarity score and provenance metadata (source, page, heading, chapter/topic/course ids) plus dict serialisation for agent consumption.

nodes.name: retrieve
nodes.summary: Embeds the query and returns the vector store's top-k hits mapped into RetrievedChunk objects, honouring optional course/chapter/topic filters.

nodes.name: format_context
nodes.summary: Joins retrieved chunks into a delimited context block with optional numbered citations for grounding LLM prompts.

nodes.name: vector_store.py
nodes.summary: pgvector persistence layer for course-scoped embeddings: collection DDL, idempotent ContentChunk upserts, deletion by document and cosine top-k search with dynamic metadata filters via raw SQL.
nodes.languageNotes: The query vector is bound as a string literal wrapped in CAST(:query AS vector) because psycopg binds Python lists as double-precision arrays, which pgvector's <=> operator rejects.

nodes.name: VectorStore
nodes.summary: Owns the collection lifecycle (ensure/delete), update-or-insert upsert semantics for ContentChunk vectors, delete-by-document cleanup and Postgres cosine search built from composable WHERE filters.

nodes.name: get_vector_store
nodes.summary: Process-wide singleton accessor returning the shared VectorStore instance.

nodes.name: registry.py
nodes.summary: Tool belt exposed to agents: RAG lookup, SearXNG web search, study-plan validation, mastery updates and duplicate-question checks packaged as named Tool descriptors.

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.summary: Named tool descriptor pairing a callable with a description and JSON-schema parameter spec for prompt injection.

nodes.name: _rag_retrieve
nodes.summary: Runs retriever.retrieve for a course/topic query and returns serialised chunk dictionaries for agent context.

nodes.name: _web_search
nodes.summary: Queries a SearXNG instance over HTTP and normalises title/url/snippet results, logging and degrading gracefully when the service is unreachable.

nodes.name: get_tools
nodes.summary: Constructs the standard Tool list (rag_search, web_search, validate_study_plan, update_mastery, check_duplicate_question) handed to agent prompts.

nodes.name: _validate_plan
nodes.summary: Normalises raw LLM plan-item dictionaries into PlanItem models and delegates to the scheduler's validator for feasibility checking against exam date and daily minutes.

nodes.name: _calc_mastery
nodes.summary: Applies the exponential moving-average update_mastery rule for one quiz result on a topic.

nodes.name: _check_duplicate
nodes.summary: Hashes a candidate question prompt and compares it against stored hashes to block duplicate questions within a course.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: Defines the BaseAgent abstract class every pipeline agent extends: process() hook, Pydantic validate_output, an output_is_empty hook that drives retry-on-empty, and a handle() wrapper adding timing, MessageBus status marks, and error capture into AgentResult.
nodes.languageNotes: Template-method pattern: subclasses implement process(); handle() centralizes timing, error capture, and bus telemetry.

nodes.name: AgentResult
nodes.summary: Minimal Pydantic result envelope carrying either a successful output payload or an error string between pipeline stages.

nodes.name: BaseAgent
nodes.summary: Abstract agent base wiring provider, DB session, message bus, and output schema; validates LLM payloads against the schema and lets content agents flag empty outputs so the runtime retries them.

nodes.name: curriculum_agent.py
nodes.summary: CurriculumAnalyzerAgent turns an uploaded course document into a structured curriculum: parses and RAG-indexes the file, prompts the LLM with the CurriculumOutput JSON schema, persists chapters/topics/objectives/prerequisites idempotently by title, and assigns indexed chunks to matching topics.
nodes.languageNotes: Overrides output_is_empty so empty {chapters: []} LLM replies trigger a bounded retry instead of silently committing an empty curriculum.

nodes.name: ObjectiveOut
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for a single learning objective produced by curriculum analysis.

nodes.name: TopicOut
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema for a topic with title, difficulty, objectives, and prerequisite titles used as the LLM structured-output contract.

nodes.name: ChapterOut
nodes.summary: Pydantic schema grouping ordered topics under a chapter for the generated curriculum.

nodes.name: CurriculumOutput
nodes.summary: Top-level LLM output contract wrapping the chapter list; its JSON schema is embedded in the analysis prompt.

nodes.name: CurriculumAnalyzerAgent
nodes.summary: Analyzes a stored document into chapters/topics/objectives: parse_document feeds index_document (RAG embeddings), one bounded LLM call produces the structure, then _persist_curriculum upserts rows and _assign_chunks_to_topics links content chunks by heading match.

nodes.name: grading_agent.py
nodes.summary: GradingAgent grades a submitted quiz attempt: deterministic objective grading via the grading service, LLM-based short-answer grading with confidence scores, flags low-confidence subjective answers needs_teacher_review, computes the attempt score, and upserts a Grade row.

nodes.name: GradedAnswer
nodes.summary: Per-answer grading result: correctness, AI score, confidence, explanation, and teacher-review flag.

nodes.name: GradingOutput
nodes.summary: Aggregate grading output with totals, percentage, and the graded answer list.

nodes.name: GradingAgent
nodes.summary: Grades each answer (objective rules vs an LLM rubric prompt for subjective), sets needs_teacher_review when subjective confidence is low, sums the score via compute_attempt_score, and creates or updates the Grade row for the attempt.

nodes.name: message.py
nodes.summary: Inter-agent messaging primitives: the AgentMessage value object and a MessageBus that persists send/mark events to the agent_messages table with duration tracking, giving observability over the multi-agent pipeline.

nodes.name: AgentMessage
nodes.summary: Immutable message record (task/correlation ids, sender/receiver, action, payload, status, duration) with as_dict serialization for persistence.

nodes.name: MessageBus
nodes.summary: Writes AgentMessageRow entries on send() and updates status/duration_ms via mark(), giving the Operations UI a durable trace of agent activity.

nodes.name: performance_agent.py
nodes.summary: PerformanceAnalysisAgent consumes a graded attempt: updates per-topic StudentMastery records, records study history, detects recurring misconceptions across recent attempts, and emits weak/strong topic lists for downstream adaptation.

nodes.name: TopicMasteryOut
nodes.summary: Mastery snapshot per topic (value, attempt count, status label) used in the agent output.

nodes.name: PerformanceOutput
nodes.summary: Agent output contract listing weak/strong topics, full mastery table, and newly detected misconceptions.

nodes.name: PerformanceAnalysisAgent
nodes.summary: Updates mastery from graded answers via student memory, builds report rows through the analytics/mastery services, and deduplicates open Misconception rows detected over recent attempts.

nodes.name: planner_agent.py
nodes.summary: StudyPlannerAgent builds or adapts study plans deterministically: loads topics with mastery weights, delegates packing/ordering to the scheduler service (build_plan/adapt_plan), validates prerequisite ordering, packs items into days, and persists a new versioned StudyPlan.
nodes.languageNotes: LLM-free by design: planning runs through the pure-Python scheduler so plans are reproducible and created in milliseconds.

nodes.name: PlanItemOut
nodes.summary: Serialized plan item (topic, day, sequence, minutes, goal, reason, status) exposed to API consumers.

nodes.name: PlannerOutput
nodes.summary: Planner result contract: plan id/version, validation verdict with errors, and the item list.

nodes.name: StudyPlannerAgent
nodes.summary: Orchestrates plan creation/adaptation: _load_topics merges Topic rows with StudentMastery into scheduler inputs, create or adapt flows produce items, validate_plan gates invalid orderings, and _persist writes a new active StudyPlan version with items.

nodes.name: quiz_agent.py
nodes.summary: QuizAgent generates assessment questions via a schema-constrained LLM prompt seeded with course context, dedupes against existing question hashes, persists Question rows, and tops up from the existing bank when generation falls short.
nodes.languageNotes: Like the curriculum agent it overrides output_is_empty so empty question lists are retried rather than accepted.

nodes.name: GeneratedQuestion
nodes.summary: LLM-produced question contract: type, prompt, choices, correct_answer map, explanation, difficulty, source_ref.

nodes.name: QuizOutput
nodes.summary: Wrapper schema carrying the generated question list for validation.

nodes.name: QuizAgent
nodes.summary: Builds the generation request from course/topic context and count/type parameters, filters duplicates via question_hash, persists new Question rows, and backfills from stored questions when the LLM returns fewer than requested.

nodes.name: recommendation_agent.py
nodes.summary: RecommendationAgent picks the next best action (e.g. review_topic) from weak topics via _decide, then renders a learner-facing narrative using an LLM prompt with a deterministic mock fallback before persisting a Recommendation row.

nodes.name: RecommendationOut
nodes.summary: Single recommendation contract: action, topic, reason fields used in agent output.

nodes.name: RecommendationOutput
nodes.summary: List wrapper for recommendations emitted by the agent.

nodes.name: RecommendationAgent
nodes.summary: Decides actions from performance weak topics, generates the explanation text via _llm_narrative (with _mock_narrative fallback), and persists Recommendation rows for the student/course.

nodes.name: supervisor.py
nodes.summary: Supervisor coordinates pipeline execution: classifies intents into agent action chains, starts/persists AgentTask rows, emits the initial message, routes each action to its receiver agent, and finalizes tasks.

nodes.name: Supervisor
nodes.summary: Intent router and task owner: classify maps intents like analyze_curriculum or quiz_submit to action sequences, start_task/finish_task manage task lifecycle rows, and _receiver_for_action dispatches work to the right agent.

nodes.name: runtime.py
nodes.summary: LangGraph-style AgentRuntime: registers all agents, threads a GraphState payload through supervisor-defined chains, executes each node with savepoint-backed retries (_run_with_retry with backoff and empty-output detection), and manages overall task success/failure.
nodes.languageNotes: Savepoint rollback per failed node attempt keeps partial DB writes from leaking between retries; retries are bounded by settings.agent_max_retries.

nodes.name: GraphState
nodes.summary: TypedDict-style state bag passed between graph nodes holding payload, per-agent results, and error accumulation.

nodes.name: AgentRuntime
nodes.summary: Compiles and runs agent graphs: build_agents instantiates the registry, compile wires supervisor chains into a dispatch graph, _run_with_retry wraps each agent.handle in savepoint+backoff logic, and run() drives start_task through finish_task.

nodes.name: logger.py
nodes.summary: Logging bootstrap: configures root logging once from Settings, exposes get_logger(name), and bind_task to attach task/correlation ids as contextual log fields.

nodes.name: _configure
nodes.summary: One-time root logger setup applying the configured level and format, guarded against duplicate handlers.

nodes.name: get_logger
nodes.summary: Returns a named logger, triggering configuration on first use.

nodes.name: bind_task
nodes.summary: Adapter adding task_id/correlation_id context to every log record for a run.

nodes.name: grading.py
nodes.summary: Pure deterministic grading helpers: stable question_hash/is_duplicate dedup keys, rule-based grade_objective for MCQ/true-false/numerical answers (numeric tolerance via _numeric_equal), compute_attempt_score totals, and rubric_default prompts.

nodes.name: question_hash
nodes.summary: Stable hash of a question prompt for cross-version deduplication.

nodes.name: is_duplicate
nodes.summary: Checks whether a hash already exists in a supplied collection.

nodes.name: grade_objective
nodes.summary: Deterministically grades mcq/true_false/numerical answers against correct_answer (case-insensitive choices, numeric tolerance), returning correctness and a default confidence.

nodes.name: compute_attempt_score
nodes.summary: Sums awarded points over graded results to produce the attempt score.

nodes.name: rubric_default
nodes.summary: Builds the default LLM rubric instructions used when grading subjective answers.

nodes.name: scheduler.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic study-plan engine: orders topics topologically over prerequisites, builds day-packed plans weighted toward low mastery and nearing exams, adapts existing plans around weak topics, and validates prerequisite ordering, coverage, and daily minute budgets.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure functions and dataclasses (no I/O) so the planner agent stays fast and testable; millisecond plan creation.

nodes.name: PlanTopic
nodes.summary: Scheduler input topic: id, title, mastery estimate, and prerequisite ids.

nodes.name: PlanItem
nodes.summary: Scheduled unit of study with day/sequence placement, estimated minutes, goal text, and to_dict serialization.

nodes.name: PlanValidation
nodes.summary: Validation verdict container listing rule violations for a candidate plan.

nodes.name: _topological_order
nodes.summary: Kahn-style sort of topics so prerequisites precede dependents in scheduling order.

nodes.name: build_plan
nodes.summary: Constructs a fresh plan: priority-weights topics by weakness/exam proximity, lays them out in topological order across days within the daily-minute budget, and assigns goals.

nodes.name: validate_plan
nodes.summary: Checks a plan against prerequisite ordering, topic coverage, and per-day duration limits, collecting violations into a PlanValidation result.

nodes.name: adapt_plan
nodes.summary: Produces a follow-up plan version that re-prioritizes weak topics and preserves progress on completed items from the previous plan.

nodes.name: _renormalise
nodes.summary: Rescales remaining study minutes so packed items fit the daily budget after adjustments.

nodes.name: base.py
nodes.summary: SQLAlchemy foundation layer providing the shared declarative Base, a pgvector-aware VectorColumn TypeDecorator, and the engine/session factory used by the entire persistence layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the TypeDecorator pattern so models can declare embedding columns with plain Python types; Base.type_annotation_map maps those annotations automatically.

nodes.name: VectorColumn
nodes.summary: TypeDecorator that binds Python float-list embeddings to a fixed-size pgvector Vector column on PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: Base
nodes.summary: Shared SQLAlchemy declarative base whose type_annotation_map lets every ORM model declare vector columns via plain annotations.

nodes.name: create_engine_and_session
nodes.summary: Creates a SQLAlchemy engine and configured sessionmaker for the resolved PostgreSQL URL.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Barrel module importing and re-exporting every ORM model so callers use a single adapted.models namespace for Course, Topic, QuizAttempt, and friends.

nodes.name: course.py
nodes.summary: Defines the core teaching-domain tables: teacher-owned Courses, student Enrollments joining students to courses, and uploaded Documents tracked through their parsing status for the RAG pipeline.

nodes.name: Course
nodes.summary: ORM table for a teacher-owned course with title/subject/exam-date metadata and relationships to enrollments, documents, and generated chapters.

nodes.name: Enrollment
nodes.summary: Association table linking a student to a course with enrollment status and joined-at timestamp.

nodes.name: Document
nodes.summary: Uploaded teaching material (PDF/text/docx) with on-disk storage path, size/page counts, and processing status/error fields consumed by the RAG ingestion flow.

nodes.name: curriculum.py
nodes.summary: Curriculum hierarchy produced by the analysis agent: Chapters group ordered Topics, Topics carry prerequisites and learning objectives, and ContentChunk rows store embedded textbook passages assigned to topics for retrieval.
nodes.languageNotes: ContentChunk.vector holds a fixed-size pgvector embedding (2048-dim Nemotron), making this table the anchor of the vector search layer.

nodes.name: Chapter
nodes.summary: Chapter row grouping ordered topics within a course and tracing back to the source document it was parsed from.

nodes.name: Topic
nodes.summary: Learnable unit inside a chapter with difficulty and description metadata, learning objectives, and prerequisite links consumed by the planner.

nodes.name: TopicPrerequisite
nodes.summary: Self-referential association declaring which topic must come before another in the dependency graph.

nodes.name: LearningObjective
nodes.summary: Coded objective statement attached to a topic, emitted during curriculum analysis.

nodes.name: ContentChunk
nodes.summary: Textbook passage with page range, heading, and source citation plus its pgvector embedding and topic/chapter/course scoping used for similarity search.

nodes.name: learning.py
nodes.summary: Learning-flow tables spanning versioned StudyPlans with daily items, generated Lessons and Questions, Quizzes with question assignments, student attempts carrying per-answer AI-grading and teacher-review flags, and finalized Grades.
nodes.languageNotes: Answer carries parallel AI grading fields (ai_score/ai_confidence/needs_teacher_review) and teacher override fields, enabling the human-in-the-loop review queue.

nodes.name: StudyPlan
nodes.summary: Versioned study plan for a student-course pair with exam date, daily-minutes budget, and lifecycle status.

nodes.name: StudyPlanItem
nodes.summary: Single day-slot entry in a study plan mapping a topic to its sequence, estimated minutes, goal, reason, and completion status.

nodes.name: Lesson
nodes.summary: Generated lesson content for a topic at a chosen difficulty level, recording which RAG chunks informed it.

nodes.name: Question
nodes.summary: Question-bank entry with type-specific payload (choices, correct answer), difficulty, deduplication hash, and learning-objective linkage.

nodes.name: Quiz
nodes.summary: Quiz container (assessment/reassessment/exit-ticket) binding questions to a student with generation config, creator, and status tracking.

nodes.name: QuizQuestion
nodes.summary: Association placing a question at a position within a quiz with its assigned difficulty.

nodes.name: QuizAttempt
nodes.summary: A student's sitting of a quiz with score rollup, submission timestamps, and the correlation id tying grading to its agent pipeline run.

nodes.name: Answer
nodes.summary: Per-question response in an attempt storing the AI grade (score, confidence, explanation), teacher override fields, and the persistent needs_teacher_review flag driving the review queue.

nodes.name: Grade
nodes.summary: Finalized attempt grade with percentage, feeding analytics, mastery updates, and teacher grade histories.

nodes.name: memory.py
nodes.summary: Student-memory tables persisting per-topic mastery with trend history, an append-only study activity log, detected misconceptions, aggregated conversation memory, key-value learning preferences, and agent-generated recommendations.

nodes.name: StudentMastery
nodes.summary: Rolling mastery estimate per student-topic pair with attempt count, trend direction, computed status, and score-history JSON.

nodes.name: StudyHistory
nodes.summary: Append-only activity log recording each study event (lesson read, quiz submitted, plan created) for a student with typed references.

nodes.name: Misconception
nodes.summary: Detected misconception for a student-topic pair with supporting evidence, lifecycle status, and resolution timestamp.

nodes.name: ConversationMemory
nodes.summary: Aggregated per-student/course interaction summary with focus topic, frequency, last-seen tracking, and rolling summary text.

nodes.name: LearningPreference
nodes.summary: Key-value preference store per user capturing personalization settings such as preferred explanation style.

nodes.name: Recommendation
nodes.summary: Agent-produced next-step recommendation with action payload, source agent, confidence, teacher-review flag, and apply/lifecycle status.

nodes.name: observability.py
nodes.summary: Observability tables behind the Operations UI: AgentTask rows track background pipeline runs, AgentMessage logs inter-agent traffic, and AuditLog records audited user actions.

nodes.name: AgentTask
nodes.summary: Persistent record of an async agent pipeline task with intent, status machine, payload/result JSON, retries, timing, and correlation id for polling clients.

nodes.name: AgentMessage
nodes.summary: Log of message-bus traffic between pipeline agents (sender, receiver, action, duration) keyed by task correlation id.

nodes.name: AuditLog
nodes.summary: Audit trail of security-relevant actions with actor role, resource type/id coordinates, IP, and correlation ids.

nodes.name: user.py
nodes.summary: Identity model: User accounts with hashed credentials and a role discriminator, extended by Teacher profiles (department) and Student profiles (grade level, daily study budget, timezone).

nodes.name: utcnow
nodes.summary: Returns the current UTC datetime used as the default timestamp for user-table created_at columns.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Base account table with unique email, password hash, full name, and role discriminator linking to teacher/student profile extensions.

nodes.name: Teacher
nodes.summary: Teacher profile extension of User adding department and the one-to-many relationship to owned courses.

nodes.name: Student
nodes.summary: Student profile extension of User with grade level, daily study minutes, timezone, and enrollment relationships.

nodes.name: teacher.py
nodes.summary: Teacher-facing API router providing class rosters, course-wide analytics, per-student grade histories, an AI-grade review queue scoped to the teacher's own courses, and manual grade overrides.
nodes.languageNotes: All endpoints gate through TeacherDep plus assert_course_owner, enforcing row-level ownership before any query runs.

nodes.name: class_students
nodes.summary: Lists students enrolled in a course together with their user details, after verifying the requesting teacher owns the course.

nodes.name: class_analytics
nodes.summary: Aggregates class-wide analytics: per-student profiles and mastery records, average topic mastery, weakest topics ranked by class performance, and open misconception counts.

nodes.name: student_grades
nodes.summary: Returns a student's quiz-attempt history for a course, joining grades and quiz titles, ordered newest-first.

nodes.name: pending_review
nodes.summary: Queues AI-graded answers flagged needs_teacher_review across only the teacher's own courses (multi-join Answer→QuizAttempt→Quiz→Course), ordered by lowest AI confidence first.

nodes.name: override_grade
nodes.summary: Lets a teacher manually override an answer's score and correctness, persisting the change and clearing the review-needed flag.

nodes.name: student_memory.py
nodes.summary: Builds and maintains each student's learning state: aggregates mastery records, misconceptions, preferences, quiz attempts, conversation memory, and study history into a StudentProfile snapshot, and persists mastery updates, study events, conversations, and preference changes.

nodes.name: StudentProfile
nodes.summary: Lightweight snapshot dataclass of a student's state: mastery map, overall mastery, weak/strong topics, open misconceptions, preferences, most recent quiz attempt, conversation foci, and recent study history.

nodes.name: build_profile
nodes.summary: Assembles a full StudentProfile by merging mastery records (course-scoped when course_id given, otherwise global), open misconceptions, learning preferences, the latest quiz attempt, most frequent conversation foci, and recent study history.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 100-line function issuing roughly seven targeted SELECTs; delegates mastery math to services.mastery and weak/strong ranking to services.analytics.

nodes.name: update_topic_mastery
nodes.summary: Upserts the StudentMastery row for a topic, appending the new score to history and recomputing mastery, trend, and status via the mastery service.

nodes.name: record_study
nodes.summary: Persists a StudyHistory row recording a study activity (e.g. lesson viewed, quiz taken) with optional topic link and JSON details.

nodes.name: record_conversation
nodes.summary: Upserts a ConversationMemory row keyed by focus topic, incrementing frequency and refreshing the summary and last-seen timestamp.

nodes.name: set_preference
nodes.summary: Upserts a LearningPreference key/value pair for a user.

nodes.name: analytics.py
nodes.summary: Pure analytics helpers that split mastery records into weak/strong topic sets, detect recurring misconceptions from graded answers (per MCQ distractor and per topic), and roll per-student mastery maps into a class-wide topic summary.
nodes.languageNotes: Stateless pure functions over plain dicts/lists — no DB access — making them trivially unit-testable.

nodes.name: weak_and_strong
nodes.summary: Splits mastery records into the weakest and strongest topic lists using configurable count limits and mastery-threshold cut-offs.

nodes.name: detect_misconceptions
nodes.summary: Heuristic misconception detector over graded answers: flags repeatedly chosen wrong MCQ options and repeated failures concentrated in the same topic, producing human-readable findings.

nodes.name: class_topic_summary
nodes.summary: Averages per-student mastery maps into a class-wide topic summary including the number of contributing students per topic, sorted weakest-first.

nodes.name: mastery.py
nodes.summary: Mastery math core: exponential-moving-average mastery updates, trend computation over score history, status-label threshold bands, and MasteryRecord construction.

nodes.name: MasteryRecord
nodes.summary: Dataclass describing one topic's mastery: current value, attempt count, trend, status label, and score history.

nodes.name: status_for
nodes.summary: Maps a mastery percentage to a status label via fixed threshold bands.

nodes.name: update_mastery
nodes.summary: Blends the latest quiz score into the running mastery value using an exponential moving average weighted by attempt count.

nodes.name: compute_trend
nodes.summary: Computes the score delta between the older and newer halves of the history window to indicate improvement or decline.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.summary: One-line convenience wrapper that delegates to status_for.

nodes.name: build_record
nodes.summary: Factory constructing a complete MasteryRecord from raw inputs: normalises mastery, computes the trend from history, and derives the status label.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template documenting every runtime environment variable for AdaptED: app metadata, CORS and JWT token settings, the PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, OpenRouter chat/embedding credentials and models, EMBEDDING_DIM=2048, and SearxNG search options. Copied to the git-ignored .env that pydantic-settings reads at startup.
nodes.languageNotes: Env-file convention: the real .env holds live credentials (OpenRouter API key, DB password) and is never committed; this example mirrors its keys with safe placeholders.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Intentionally empty placeholder readme; the project's real conventions and running history are kept in AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md instead.

nodes.name: opencode.json
nodes.summary: Configuration for the opencode CLI coding agent in this repository, using the instructions array to auto-load AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md as instruction context for every session.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: uv/hatchling package manifest for adapted v0.1.0 declaring the FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + pgvector + Streamlit + OpenAI/LangGraph dependency stack, dev tooling (pytest with asyncio auto mode, ruff at line-length 100 / py312), and wheel packaging of the src/adapted layout.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 735 [dependency-groups] for dev deps and hatchling as the build backend targeting the src layout (packages = ["src/adapted"]).

nodes.name: .python-version
nodes.summary: Pyenv version pin selecting Python 3.12 as the interpreter for the project runtime and tooling.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Generated ignore-rule configuration for the Understand-Anything analysis pipeline, excluding bytecode, env files, storage artifacts, databases, and caches while explicitly keeping docs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses .gitignore syntax (globs, # comments, ! negation); most test-pattern entries are left commented as optional toggles.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the AdaptED backend declaring the project name and __version__ 0.1.0.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package initializer marking the API routers package; individual routers are registered directly in the FastAPI app factory.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: Streamlit frontend entrypoint providing login/register, role-based sidebar navigation, and every teacher view (dashboard, curriculum, class analytics, review queue, operations) and student view (dashboard, study plan, learn, quizzes, progress, recommendations) on top of the APIClient.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses session_state heavily for auth/course/task flow, @st.dialog for destructive confirms, and an @st.fragment(run_every=...) poller to deliver background LLM task results without blocking the page.

nodes.name: client.py
nodes.summary: Thin httpx-based REST client wrapping every AdaptED backend endpoint (auth, users, courses, documents, curriculum, agents/tasks, lessons, quizzes, study plans, students, teacher classes, audit logs, health) with bearer-token headers and APIError translation.

nodes.name: auth_screen
nodes.summary: Renders the login and register tabs with role selection and optional grade/daily-minutes fields; on success stores token and user in session_state and reruns.

nodes.name: sidebar
nodes.summary: Builds the role-based navigation radio (teacher vs student page sets) plus logout button, honoring a pending-nav marker set by 'Open course' clicks.

nodes.name: _render_curriculum
nodes.summary: Renders generated chapters and topics as expanders with objectives and estimated minutes, showing an informational placeholder when the curriculum is empty.

nodes.name: teacher_dashboard
nodes.summary: Teacher home page: course-creation form plus course cards with Open course, Clear contents, and Delete actions wired to confirmation dialogs.

nodes.name: confirm_delete_document
nodes.summary: @st.dialog modal warning that document deletion cannot be undone, with Cancel and destructive confirm buttons calling delete_document.

nodes.name: confirm_clear_course
nodes.summary: @st.dialog modal confirming removal of all items in a course while keeping the course shell.

nodes.name: confirm_delete_course
nodes.summary: @st.dialog modal confirming permanent course deletion, also clearing selected_course_id when the open course is removed.

nodes.name: teacher_curriculum
nodes.summary: Three-tab course workspace: Documents (upload, analyze-curriculum trigger, delete), Curriculum (generated chapters/topics), and Enroll (student search plus raw-ID fallback).

nodes.name: _run_analysis
nodes.summary: Kicks off the async analyze_curriculum agent run and records the returned task_id in pending-task state instead of blocking on a spinner.

nodes.name: _render_pending_task
nodes.summary: Auto-refreshing fragment (run_every=4s) that polls the background task, shows a running badge, then routes success/failure results onward and clears pending state.

nodes.name: _store_task_result
nodes.summary: Maps a completed pipeline task into session_state by kind: refetches generated lessons/quizzes or rebuilds the six-agent quiz-submit result for rendering.

nodes.name: teacher_class
nodes.summary: Class analytics page: student/quiz-count metrics, topic mastery progress bars, weak-topic warnings, and per-student grade histories in expanders.

nodes.name: teacher_review_queue
nodes.summary: Lists low-confidence AI-graded answers flagged for human review, ordered by confidence, with a score/correctness override form per answer.

nodes.name: student_dashboard
nodes.summary: Student home page listing enrolled courses with subject and description captions.

nodes.name: student_study_plan
nodes.summary: Shows the day-by-day study plan for the selected course with Create plan and Adapt plan buttons that start async planner runs.

nodes.name: student_learn
nodes.summary: Lesson workspace where students generate per-topic lessons at standard/beginner/advanced levels and read the rendered sections.

nodes.name: student_quizzes
nodes.summary: Quiz workflow: generate assessment/reassessment/exit-ticket quizzes, answer MCQ/true-false/numerical questions in forms, and submit asynchronously.

nodes.name: _render_quiz_result
nodes.summary: Renders grading percentage plus weak/strong topics, the recommendation, and flags for the adapted plan, targeted lesson, and reassessment quiz.

nodes.name: student_progress
nodes.summary: Progress page with overall mastery metric, per-topic mastery bars, learning preferences, and recent quiz performance.

nodes.name: student_recommendations
nodes.summary: Lists the student's recommendations with status badges and a mark-as-applied action.

nodes.name: operations_view
nodes.summary: Operations dashboard surfacing /health status, agent task list with refresh, inter-agent messages, and audit logs.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: App entrypoint: gates on authentication, renders the sidebar, dispatches to the role-appropriate view based on the nav radio, and appends the pending-task notifier.

nodes.name: APIError
nodes.summary: Exception raised for non-2xx backend responses, carrying the server's detail message so the UI can surface actionable errors.

nodes.name: APIClient
nodes.summary: Facade over httpx.Client exposing one typed method per backend endpoint; owns base URL/token state, injects bearer headers, and converts error payloads into APIError.
nodes.languageNotes: Central _get/_post/_patch/_delete helpers keep each endpoint method down to a single line; multipart upload bypasses the JSON header helper.

layers.name: UI Layer
layers.description: Streamlit web interface serving the teacher and student pages, together with the typed APIClient that fronts every backend endpoint.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: FastAPI routers and dependency guards exposing auth, courses, documents, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, classes, and ops endpoints, plus the shared Pydantic request/response contracts in schemas.

layers.name: Agent Orchestration Layer
layers.description: The multi-agent adaptive-learning pipeline: seven specialized agents (curriculum, planner, lesson, quiz, grading, performance, recommendation) with their base class and message bus, orchestrated through the LangGraph-style graph runtime, tool registry, and background ThreadPoolExecutor task runner.

layers.name: Service Layer
layers.description: Domain business logic for AI answer grading, deterministic study-plan scheduling, class analytics aggregation, and student topic-mastery computation.

layers.name: Knowledge Retrieval (RAG) Layer
layers.description: RAG stack that parses uploaded textbooks, chunks content, embeds it via query-aware Nemotron vectors, searches pgvector, and maintains the curriculum and student memory stores.

layers.name: LLM Integration Layer
layers.description: Provider-agnostic chat and embedding abstraction registering OpenRouter free-model access (with attribution headers, timeouts, and float encoding) alongside a deterministic offline mock provider.

layers.name: Data Layer
layers.description: SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, courses, curriculum, learning records, conversation memory, and observability, plus the fail-fast PostgreSQL/pgvector engine, pgvector column type, and session management.

layers.name: Application Core
layers.description: FastAPI application factory wiring routers and startup hooks, pydantic-settings configuration loaded from .env, JWT and password-hashing security primitives, and structured logging.

layers.name: Project Configuration & Documentation
layers.description: Root-level project metadata: uv/packaging definition (pyproject.toml), Python version pin, environment-variable template, opencode assistant configuration, analysis ignore file, and the README.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Start where the server starts: main.py defines create_app(), the FastAPI application factory that initialises the PostgreSQL/pgvector schema on startup, wires CORS, registers all thirteen API routers (auth, courses, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, students, teacher, users, agent ops, logs), and exposes GET /health. Every route you will meet later in this tour hangs off this one factory. Note that README.md is intentionally an empty placeholder - the project's real conventions and running history live in AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md.

tour.title: Configuration & Project Setup
tour.description: Building on the app factory from Step 1, config.py is the central pydantic-settings object loaded from the repo-root .env: PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, OpenRouter chat/embedding credentials and model names, EMBEDDING_DIM=2048, JWT secrets, RAG limits and retry knobs. Nearly every module in the graph imports these settings (fan-in 16), so understanding what is tunable here explains behaviour everywhere else. .env.example documents every variable, and pyproject.toml declares the stack itself: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, pgvector, Streamlit and OpenAI/LangGraph dependencies managed with uv.

tour.title: Database Bootstrap: Postgres + pgvector
tour.description: session.py has the highest fan-in of any infrastructure module (22 importers): it resolves and connect-probes the database URL at import time and fails fast if Postgres is unreachable - there is deliberately no SQLite fallback. It exposes SessionLocal, the get_db dependency and session_scope helpers used by every router and worker thread, plus init/reset routines that create the pgvector extension. base.py supplies the shared declarative Base and the pgvector-aware VectorColumn used by the embedding columns you will see in Step 11.
tour.languageLesson: SQLAlchemy's TypeDecorator pattern lets base.py wrap the Postgres-only pgvector Vector(2048) type behind one portable Python column type, so ORM models stay readable while the SQL side gets native vector storage.

tour.title: Domain Models: Identity & Teaching
tour.description: These three modules define the teaching domain's vocabulary. user.py holds User accounts with a role discriminator plus Teacher and Student profiles (department, grade level, daily study budget). course.py adds teacher-owned Courses, Enrollments joining students to courses, and uploaded Documents tracked through their parsing status - the entry point for everything the AI pipeline produces. curriculum.py stores the generated hierarchy: Chapters grouping ordered Topics with prerequisites and learning objectives, and ContentChunk rows carrying embedded textbook passages assigned to topics for later retrieval.

tour.title: Learning Records & Observability Tables
tour.description: Where Step 4 stored the static teaching domain, learning.py records the dynamic learning flow: versioned StudyPlans with daily items, generated Lessons and Questions, Quizzes, student QuizAttempts whose individual Answers carry both AI-grading scores and a persistent needs_teacher_review flag, and finalized Grades. memory.py persists each student's evolving state - per-topic mastery with trend history, an append-only study log, detected misconceptions, learning preferences and agent recommendations. observability.py backs the Operations UI with AgentTask runs, inter-agent AgentMessages and an AuditLog of audited user actions.

tour.title: Security, Guards & API Contracts
tour.description: This step shows how every request is authenticated and validated. passwords.py wraps bcrypt hashing and constant-time verification, while jwt.py issues and decodes expiring HS-signed access tokens. deps.py (fan-in 12) is the shared dependency layer: JWT bearer extraction, role-based guards such as TeacherDep, and ownership/enrollment assertion helpers that every router reuses. schemas/api.py is the complete Pydantic v2 contract layer covering requests and responses for all thirteen routers - the single source of truth for what the API accepts and returns.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI dependency injection: functions like get_db or current_teacher are declared once in deps.py and pulled into endpoints via Depends() parameters, so authentication and session handling are composed declaratively instead of repeated in each router.

tour.title: The REST Surface
tour.description: These four routers illustrate the patterns shared by all thirteen registered in Step 1. auth.py creates Users plus their Teacher/Student profiles on registration and issues JWT TokenResponses. courses.py spans course creation, enrollment, document upload/status, and cascading deletes (document, contents, whole course) with audit logging and on-disk file cleanup - the widest router by fan-out. quizzes.py shows the async pattern: fast authorization checks first, then attempt/answer rows persisted before the grading chain launches in the background. teacher.py serves class rosters, analytics, per-student grade histories, and the review queue scoped strictly to the teacher's own low-confidence subjective answers.

tour.title: Async Task Runner & Agent Orchestration
tour.description: LLM calls on free models are slow, so nothing blocks a request: runner.py persists an AgentTask row and submits the pipeline to a ThreadPoolExecutor, letting endpoints return status='started' plus a task_id within milliseconds, and guarantees failure marking even on crashes. supervisor.py classifies intents (analyze_curriculum, generate_lesson, quiz_submit, ...) into agent action chains and starts the task. graph/runtime.py is the LangGraph-style executor that threads a GraphState payload through those chains, running each agent inside savepoint-backed retries with backoff and empty-output detection. message.py's MessageBus records every inter-agent send/mark event so the whole conversation is observable in the Operations UI.
tour.languageLesson: concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor offloads blocking LLM calls from request threads. Because SQLAlchemy sessions are not thread-safe, each pool worker builds its own SessionLocal() rather than sharing the request's session.

tour.title: Agent Framework & Content Agents
tour.description: base.py defines the BaseAgent contract every pipeline agent extends: a process() hook, Pydantic validate_output, and an output_is_empty hook that drives retry-on-empty when the flaky free LLM returns schema-valid but useless payloads like {"chapters": []}. Three content-producing agents build on it: curriculum_agent parses an uploaded document, RAG-indexes it, and persists chapters/topics/objectives idempotently by title; lesson_agent combines retrieved textbook chunks, learning objectives and the student profile into a levelled lesson; quiz_agent generates schema-constrained questions, dedupes them by hash, and tops up from the existing question bank.
tour.languageLesson: Template Method via Python ABCs: BaseAgent.handle() centrally adds timing, MessageBus status marks and error capture around the abstract process() hook, so subclasses supply only the varying behaviour.

tour.title: The Adaptive Feedback Loop
tour.description: After a quiz submit (Step 7), four agents close the adaptation loop. grading_agent grades deterministically for MCQ/true-false/numerical answers but uses the LLM with confidence scores for short answers, flagging anything below threshold as needs_teacher_review. performance_agent converts the graded attempt into per-topic mastery updates, study history and recurring-misconception detections, emitting weak/strong topic lists. recommendation_agent picks the next best action (e.g. review_topic) and renders it as a learner-facing narrative. planner_agent then delegates to the deterministic scheduler to rebuild a new versioned StudyPlan targeted at the weak topics - the system literally rewrites tomorrow's plan after every assessment.

tour.title: RAG Knowledge Pipeline
tour.description: This five-stage pipeline grounds every generated lesson and quiz in the actual uploaded textbook. parser.py extracts clean per-page text from PDF, TXT/MD and DOCX; chunker.py splits pages into overlapping heading-aware chunks that carry page ranges so answers can cite their source; embeddings.py embeds texts in passage mode for indexing and query mode for search over the query-aware Nemotron model; vector_store.py performs idempotent ContentChunk upserts and cosine top-k search with course-scoped metadata filters directly against pgvector; retriever.py formats the top chunks into citation-ready context blocks that the content agents from Step 9 inject into their prompts.

tour.title: LLM Provider Abstraction
tour.description: The agents never talk to a vendor SDK directly. base.py defines the provider-agnostic contract: a request envelope pairing a prompt with its JSON schema, plus abstract chat/embed methods. openai_compatible.py implements it for OpenRouter's free models - JSON-schema-constrained generation, dimension-validated embeddings, attribution headers and the configured 120-second timeout bounding every call. mock.py fabricates deterministic curricula, lessons, quizzes and grades offline for fully reproducible test runs. registry.py maps configured provider names to implementations behind lru-cached accessors, degrading gracefully to MockProvider when credentials are absent.
tour.languageLesson: functools.lru_cache turns the registry's plain factory functions into per-process singletons: providers (and their HTTP clients) are constructed once and reused across every agent run.

tour.title: Deterministic Services & Student Memory
tour.description: Not everything should be an LLM call. mastery.py is the pure math core: exponential-moving-average mastery updates, trend computation and status-label thresholds. analytics.py splits mastery into weak/strong topic sets, detects recurring misconceptions per MCQ distractor, and rolls students up into class-wide summaries. scheduler.py builds study plans deterministically - topological ordering over prerequisites, day packing weighted toward low mastery and nearing exams - and validates coverage and minute budgets. student_memory.py aggregates mastery, misconceptions, preferences, attempts, conversations and study history into the StudentProfile snapshot that personalizes prompts in Steps 9-10.

tour.title: Streamlit Frontend
tour.description: The tour ends where users begin. app.py is the Streamlit entrypoint providing login/register, role-based sidebar navigation, and every teacher view (dashboard, curriculum with document upload and agent triggers, class analytics, review queue, operations) plus every student view (dashboard, study plan, learn, quizzes, progress, recommendations). It polls background tasks started in Step 8 and notifies users in place while lessons and gradings run. client.py is the thin httpx REST client wrapping all backend endpoints with bearer-token headers and clean APIError translation - the only bridge between UI state and the API surface you met in Steps 6-7.
